lemma isEquivalent_self (f : ℕ → ℝ) : f ~[atTop] f := by
  unfold Asymptotics.IsEquivalent
  rw [Metric.tendsto_atTop]
  intro ε hε
  use 0
  intro n _
  have : dist (f n / f n) 1 = 0 := by
    by_cases h : f n = 0
    · rw [h, zero_div, zero_div, dist_self]
    · rw [div_self h, dist_self]
  rw [this]
  exact hε
